summary: Re-read the District's DuPuis page, SUL page and SUL FAQ: everything recorded (free SUL reservation, no hookups, the District's only dump station for registered campers, 8 consecutive days per permit and 30 a year, RV/travel trailer camping with 'no length limit', non-equestrian campers in their own half of the campground) still matches. No storm-closure notice for DuPuis (the SUL page only says 'Some lands may have campgrounds ... temporarily closed'). Not stated: site count, toilets/showers, season.
